calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Aug-22-2019 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and a Minor.
Dept. 514. Judge: Gail Dekreon. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioner Amber Rose Orantes, a/k/a Amber R. Orantes, a/k/a Amber Orantes, present in pro per.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name of the Adult were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition for change of name of an adult should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of petitioner from Amber Rose Orantes, a/k/a Amber R. Orantes, a/k/a Amber Orantes, to Iyana Marli DePalma.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

Request for Change of Name of the Minor from Evan Chales Orantes-Crowder to Evan Antonie DePalma is DENIED for the following reasons:

(1) Father of the minor did not sign the petition for change of name; and
(2) Petitioner did not provide the Court with any documentation as to her efforts to locate the minor's father.

NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Jun-25-2019 Reset To Aug-22-19 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 514. Judge: Newton Lam. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

No appearance by petitioner Amber Rose Orantes, a/k/a Amber R. Orantes, a/k/a Amber Orantes.
Rachel Madison, sister of petitioner, was present and informs the Clerk in Department 514 that petitioner is unable to attend this morning's proceedings and requests that the matter be continued.
No Proof of Publication in the file.

Good cause appearing, the matter is CONTINUED to August 22, 2019 for further proceedings. The Court shall prepare the Amended Order to Show Cause for Change of Name.
